method.relative_clock: real2400..2850 -> relative1..451; subtract first cumulative row and exclude its event counts

terminal_treatment.rule: absent next frame, last on verified terminal, reachable endpoint or bounded one-simulation-step position overshoot; no TMINNETTOT assumption

method.appearance: First observation inside this window, not proven internal generation; pre2400 reappearance history unavailable

native_errors.scope: ID + last link + warning within 1s of disappearance upper frame; flags do not subtract or relabel canonical TD/unknown

completion_evidence.scope: Existing completion receipt only; no repeated native audit; independent LSA verdict unchanged

read_limits.method: Binary seek to the requested start; stream only the requested frame interval. File size plus 1 MiB is a byte ceiling allowing seek/header overhead, not a full-scan request.

fzp.scope: All vehicles in the same single bounded 451-frame read; no full-run scan
